answer: A sybil attacker can mint a thousand fake agents overnight, but a dune of sand still needs a foundation: require every identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, so each clone costs real capital. Then let reputation accumulate like a sonnet, line by line, through signed vouches from established peers, never self-written. Finally, publish each attestation as a relic: a public, verifiable receipt on the ledger, so a cluster of fresh clones with no history stands out before it can vote or earn.
